items.title: File Einspruch against revocation of Kindergeld
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch bei der Familienkasse Beispielweser eingelegt werden, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The letter itself fixes the delivery day: 'Der Bescheid gilt als am vierten Tag nach der oben genannten Aufgabe zur Post bekannt gegeben.' The stated Aufgabe zur Post is Saturday 21.11.2026. Day 4 after 21.11.2026 is Wednesday 25.11.2026 (not a weekend/holiday, so no shift under § 108 Abs. 3 AO) — this is the deemed Bekanntgabe date. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 108 Abs. 1 AO the one-month Einspruch period starts the next day (26.11.2026) and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month with the same number as the start day of the delivery (25.), i.e. 25.12.2026. 25.12.2026 is Erster Weihnachtstag, a nationwide public holiday (and in NI, the sender's seat, also a holiday), so under § 108 Abs. 3 AO the deadline moves to the next working day. 26.12.2026 (2. Weihnachtstag) and 27.12.2026 (Sunday) are also non-working, so the deadline falls on Monday 28.12.2026.

items.title: Kindergeld entitlement for son Lukas ends
items.quote: Nach Abschluss der Ausbildung besteht nach § 32 Abs. 4 EStG kein Anspruch mehr; die Festsetzung heben wir deshalb mit Wirkung ab 01.01.2027 auf.
items.computation: The Festsetzung is revoked 'mit Wirkung ab 01.01.2027', i.e. entitlement ends with the last day before that date. The last day Lukas still counts as a child for Kindergeld purposes is therefore 31.12.2026.

items.title: Final Kindergeld payment (December 2026)
items.quote: Bis einschließlich Dezember 2026 zahlen wir das Kindergeld von 259,00 € im Monat weiter.
items.computation: The Familienkasse confirms it will keep paying the monthly 259,00 € up to and including the month of December 2026; no specific pay-out day within the month is given, so the last day of that final entitlement month, 31.12.2026, is used as the due date.

warnings: The letter is dated Thursday 19.11.2026 but states 'Aufgabe zur Post' as Saturday 21.11.2026 — an unusual combination (mail is not normally handed to the post office on a date after the letter's own date, and rarely on a Saturday); double-check the actual envelope postmark, since if the real posting day was earlier than 21.11.2026 the Einspruch deadline could fall a few days earlier than 28.12.2026.
The letter's recipient address (35576 Beispielwetzlar) is in Hesse, not in Nordrhein-Westfalen; worth checking that this is the correct, current address on file with the Familienkasse.

The deemed-delivery rule only applies if the letter was sent by ordinary post; if it was instead formally served (yellow envelope / 'zugestellt am'), the one-month period would run from that service date instead.
